# sleep-aur 3.1.5

## Features

- sleep-aur checks for a new release when a command is run, at most once every 2 hours.
- The check is cached, so normal commands do not make network requests.
- A new version is announced once, with instructions to run `sleep-aur self update`.
- Offline checks fail silently.
- New configuration options: `UPDATE_CHECK` and `UPDATE_CHECK_INTERVAL`.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/the-sleepless/sleep-aur/compare/v3.1.4...v3.1.5
